caseNameFull: Hampton, Chairman, U. S. Civil Service Commission v. Fitzgerald

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. Application for extension of time to file petition for writ of certiorari presented to The Chief Justice, and by him referred to the Court, granted. It is ordered that the time for filing such petition be, and the same is hereby, extended to and including January 13, 1973.
